results.requirement: Candidate patch applied to isolated workspace leaves primary checkout completely unchanged

results.requirement: restoreOriginalWorkspace cleanly reverts candidate workspace to pristine state

results.expectedBehavior: Workspace matches pristine copy exactly
results.actualBehavior: Restoration clean: true

results.scenario: Stop isolated app and assert port is closed and unreachable
results.expectedBehavior: Process terminated, port freed, lock released
results.actualBehavior: Port freed: true

results.requirement: Passing baseline reproduction terminates run as BLOCKED without proposing patch
results.scenario: Execute repair graph with baseline outcome PASSED
results.expectedBehavior: Transitions directly to finalizeRun, sets state: BLOCKED, proposal undefined
results.actualBehavior: State: BLOCKED; StopReason: "The reported failure was not reproduced on original source."; Proposal: undefined

results.requirement: Graph pauses at AWAITING_REVIEW, persists checkpoint, and resumes on exact review to VERIFIED
results.scenario: Invoke graph to interrupt, verify checkpoint file exists, then resume with Command
results.expectedBehavior: Paused state: AWAITING_REVIEW; Checkpoint written; Final state: VERIFIED
results.actualBehavior: Paused state: AWAITING_REVIEW; Checkpoint on disk: true; Final state: VERIFIED

results.requirement: Rejects approval resumption if proposal hash does not match candidate proposal exactly
results.scenario: Submit approval review with altered SHA-256 hash
results.expectedBehavior: Throws Exact approval binding failed error without applying patch
results.actualBehavior: Tamper rejected: true

results.requirement: Durable checkpoint reload enables a distinct OS process to load state from disk and resume the exact approved proposal with double-apply protection
results.scenario: Process A creates checkpoint on disk and exits; Process B in separate OS process loads persisted state, resumes approved proposal, and validates idempotent interruption safety
results.expectedBehavior: Process A exits 0 on pause, Process B exits 0 with VERIFIED, and idempotent resume succeeds without double-apply error
results.actualBehavior: Process A exit OK: true, Process B resume VERIFIED: true, Idempotent resume: true

results.requirement: Rejects proposal containing stale or non-matching oldContent
results.scenario: Validate proposal with non-existent oldContent string
results.expectedBehavior: Returns valid: false with descriptive error
results.actualBehavior: Valid: false; Error: "oldContent not found in src/store/cartStore.ts. Proposal may be stale or mismatched."

results.requirement: Rejects proposal attempting to mutate files outside apps/minishop/src/
results.scenario: Validate proposal targeting package.json
results.expectedBehavior: Returns valid: false with edit scope violation
results.actualBehavior: Valid: false; Error: "Editing is not permitted for path: package.json. Allowed: apps/minishop/src/**/* (excluding tests and configs)."
